tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: rdo rje rnam 'joms sgrub pa'i 'phrin las bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rgya gar skad du: badz+ra bhin+dhā ra sā dha na ma no pi ka karma nā ma: bod skad du: rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sgrub pa'i phrin las zhes bya ba: bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo: gang zhig 'khor ba'i las ngan spang: yang dag lam du 'jug 'dod na: gsang bdag rdo rje bsgrub par bya: yid 'ong nyams dga' gtsang ma'i gnas: tho rangs snga dro dang po la: bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas kyang: gtsang ma'i gos bgo dri spos byug: oṃ shud+dhe bi shud+dha ye swā hā: chu gtsang khrus dang bsang gtor bya: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon song nas: skad cig lha yi nga rgyal gyis: rang lus bsrung zhing mtshams gcod bya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ hūm̐: dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las: hūm̐ las rdo rje zhu ba las: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag mdog: ral pa gyen brdzes rgya gram phyar: g.yon pa sdigs mdzub thugs kar 'dzin: steng 'og phyogs mtshams me dpung 'bar: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor 'bar ba chen po'i dbus kyi bdag: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs: hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo rngam brjid che: bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: bdud dang log 'dren thams cad 'dul mdzad pa: drag po'i stangs stabs 'gying bag stabs su bzhugs: bdud 'dul khro bo'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig: 'gro drug khro bo'i thugs rjes 'dul bar gzigs: shin tu 'jigs pa'i cha lugs drag po bstan: sku mdog nag po hūm̐ hūm̐ sgra sgrog pa: bdud rtsi thal sbyor mtshams las ma 'da' zhig: phyag gnyis bdud rtsi thal sbyor 'dzin zhing brjid: dbu skra sma ra ag tshom gyen brdzes ser: thugs mchog chos kyi sku yi ngo bo nyid: bgegs las mthar byed khro bo'i rol mtshams las: 'da' bar byed na bgegs rnams thal bar rlog: tad+ya thā: oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra: ma tha ma tha badz+ra: dhu na dhu na badz+ra: da ha da ha badz+ra:

pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra: dha ra dha ra badz+ra: dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra: dhā ru ṇa dhā ru ṇa badz+ra: tshin+dha tshin+dha badz+ra: bhin+dha bhin+dha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: de nas ye shes lha rnams kun: bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las ni: 'od 'phros spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ na mo bskal pa thog ma med pa nas: sdig pa'i las ngan bsags pa ma lus rnams: dus 'di nyid du so sor bshags par bgyi: bdag nyid dang po khyed la gus pa yis: gsang ba'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la: yang dag don la gnas phyir skyabs su mchi: bde bar gshegs pa ma lus thams cad dang: 'gro ba'i don mdzad byang chub sems dpa' la: bdag gis gces par 'dzin pa'i lus 'di 'bul: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis: dge ba'i las rnams bgyis pa thams cad kun: dus 'di nyid du byang chub mchog tu bsngo: bla med dkon mchog gsum dang gdung 'dzin rnams: mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro drug don la bzhugs: chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor du gsol: sarba satwa ni: bho ta ya bho ta ya: bho ti tsit+ta sa ma ti hūm̐: ye shes sems dpa' bdag la bstim: rol mo'i sgra sgrog byin dbab pa: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ hūm̐: chos sku nam mkha' lta bu las: gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis byung nas: 'gro drug kun la phan mdzad phyir: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs: phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams: ngo bo nyid kyis dag mod kyang: sems can nyon mongs sbyang ba'i phyir: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob cig: sa ma ya ā be sha ya a ā: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ hūm̐: a las ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor 'khyil: dhū las dri zhim spos ngad ldan: pu las me tog gsal bar bkram: ā las gsal ba'i sgron me 'bar: oṃ las rin chen gtor ma brjid: lha mo rnams kyis 'jig rten gang: a dhū pu ā oṃ āḥhūm̐: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ:

hūm̐: dang po stong pa'i ngang la gnas: rang rig yi ge hūm̐ du gyur: e las mthing nag nam mkha'i klong: yaṃ las sngo skya rlung gi dal: khaṃ las dkar po chu yi dal: suṃ las ser po sa yi dal: raṃ las dmar po me yi dal: de steng bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang: sgo dang ka ba rgyan rnams kun: sna tshogs rin po che las grub: lha snam rin chen pha gu dang: drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab 'tsher: 'dod yon lha mo mang pos brgyan: mdzes pa'i me tog dpag bsam shing: snyan pa'i sgra skad sna tshogs sgrog: dbus dang pad+ma 'dab bzhi la: paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan: ma dang a las nyi zla brtsegs: nang la phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i klu: dbus su klu chen dregs pa'i gdan: de steng rang rig yi ge hūm̐: de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las: rdo rje rtse lnga pa ru gyur: de las 'phro 'dus bskyed pa'i lha: dbus su khro bo rnam 'joms ni: sngo nag rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: shar du khro bo gtum po ni: mthing nag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: lho ru khro bo be con ni: ser nag rin chen dril bu 'dzin: nub tu khro bo rta mchog ni: dmar nag rdo rje pad+ma 'dzin: byang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil: ljang nag rdo rje rgya gram 'dzin: kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra ser: dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil: stag lpags sbrul gyi rgyan dang ldan: spyi bo mgrin pa thugs ka gsum: 'khor lo pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kun: lus srung sngags 'dis gur du gtams: sarba bhi dhā ra badz+ra badz+ra: s+pho ṭa badz+ra badz+ra: ma tha badz+ra badz+ra: aṭ+ṭa ha sa nī la badz+ra: su badz+ra ye swā hā: rang gi sa bon 'od 'phros pas: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la: bdag gis dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: dbang bskur rgya yis btab par bya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ hūm̐: sems can nyon mongs dri ma sbyang ba dang:

bdag gi tshogs gnyis rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir: ye shes spyan dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis: gnas mchog dam pa 'dir ni gshegs su gsol: chos kyi dbyings nas thugs rjes bzhengs nas kyang: gzugs sku dam pa gnyis kyis 'gro don mdzad: 'og min gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ha ra ha ra sa mā dza: badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā: pra ha ra pra ha ra: badz+ra pra bhañdza nā ya swā hā: sa ma ya dza: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: mdun gyi mkha' la byon par bsam: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ hūm̐: 'dir ni mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: thugs rjes brtse ba'i sems can don mdzad pa: bla med byang chub sems ni rgyas bya'i phyir: bde gshegs rgyal ba thams cad bzhugs su gsol: ma tis+thi ra badz+ra: shu tis+thi ra badz+ra: pra tis+thi ra badz+ra: ma hā badz+ra: a pra ti ha ta badz+ra: a mo gha badz+ra: e h+ye hi badz+ra: shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra ye swā hā: bdag don mdzad phyir bzhugs su gsol: de nas bde gshegs thams cad kyis: bum pa bdud rtsis bkang nas kyang: dkyil 'khor lha la dbang bskur ro: na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ: sarba ba le ta a badz+ra badz+ra: dza ya ma hā ba le: ka ta be: ta tra be: a tsa le: ma dha la: mā he: a ti badz+ra: ma hā ba le: bhe ga ra na ra na: 'di ni lha yis dbang bskur rtags: gtso bo'i dbu la rigs lnga brgyan: khro bo bzhi la rigs bzhis brgyan: de nas lha la phyag 'tshal ba: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ hūm̐: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na: gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags 'chang ba'i rigs: log 'dren bgegs 'joms sdig sgrib kun sel ba'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo rat+na tra yā ya: na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye: ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye: na mo pu ru ṣā ya ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul bar bya: hūm̐: spos dang dri bzang chu dang 'o ma dag: phyag dang zhabs bsil ched du dbul bar bya: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ti ti hūm̐ khaṃ: oṃ badz+ra pā d+yāṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā:

hūm̐: gsel dngul byu ru dung dang mu tig shel: zangs lcags sman dang 'bru sna ga pur dang: tsan dan gur gum gtsang ma'i ar+ghaṃ dang: bdug spos me tog mar me dri chab dang: lha yi zhal zas bshos gtsang mchod pa 'bul: bdag la thugs rjes dgongs te bzhes su gsol: oṃ ma hā a mṛta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai wid+ya hūm̐: hūm̐: sgeg dang bzhad dang 'gugs pa'i stabs su bzhugs: spos dang zhal zas thogs pa'i phyag rgya la: me tog 'bul ba'i tshul du mchod par bzhes: mar me snang gsal sgron me 'bar ba la: dri chab sku la byug pa'i mchod par bzhes: sgeg ma me long 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya la: rin chen phreng thogs ma yi mchod pa 'bul: glu snyan pi waṃ 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya la: brkyang bskum gar stabs brjid pa'i mchod pa 'bul: na mo rat+na tra yā ya: na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye: ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye: sarba pū dza hūm̐: mchod pa 'bul zhing bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor 'bar ba chen po'i dbus kyi bdag: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs: hūm̐ las byung ba'i khro bo rngam brjid che: rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: bdud dang log 'dren thams cad 'dul mdzad pa: drag po'i stangs stabs 'gying bag stabs su bzhugs: khro bo gtum po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'gro drug khro bo'i thugs rjes 'dul bar gzigs: shin tu 'jigs pa'i cha lugs drag por ston: sku mdog ser nag hūm̐ hūm̐ sgra sgrog pa: khro bo be con sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsung: chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje'i thugs: spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngam brjid sku: khro bo rta mchog sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ljang nag phyag gnyis rgya gram 'dzin zhing brjid:

dbu skra sma ra smin ma gyen du brdzes: thugs mchog rdo rje chos kyi ngo bo nyid: khro bo 'khyil ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bzlas pa sngags kyi rim pa ni: lhag chad sngags kyi skyon rnams spang: nyi zla'i gwa 'ur bcug nas kyang: sems dpa' sum brtsegs ldan par bzla: bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' yi: thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' bsgom: de yi thugs kar nyi ma'i dal: de yi steng du gzungs sngags 'khyil: steng nas zla ba'i gur phub bsam: snying po'i don ni 'di lta ste: mi chod mi shigs bden pa'i don: sra ba brtan pa'i rang bzhin te: thams cad du yang thogs pa med: de bzhin pham pa med pa 'o: de nas gzungs rnams ring thung gsum ka bzla: na mo rat+na tra yā ya: na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye: ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: rdo rje rnam 'jom snying po 'di: yig 'bru nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa: grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum tsho gcig: sgo gsum gus pas bzla bar bya: oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha pra ti tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: bhin+dha bhin+dha ma hā ki' li kī la ya swā hā: shar phyogs khro bo'i snying po 'di: yi ge 'bru ni bcu bdun pa 'o: oṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha kro dha kī li kī la ya swā hā: lho phyogs khro bo'i snying po 'di: yi ge 'bru ni bcu gnyis pa 'o: oṃ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa kī li kī la ya swā hā: nub phyogs khro bo'i snying po 'di: yi ge 'bru ni bcu bzhi pa 'o: oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya badz+ra kī li kī la ya swā hā: byang phyogs khro bo'i snying po 'di: yi ge 'bru ni bco brgyad pa 'o: khro bo bzhi yi snying po 'di: khri tsho bdun bdun bzla bar bya: pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du: bsnyen pa'i las la brtson par bya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ me tog 'thu dang mchod rten 'dzegs: rgyal khams kha lo bsgyur ba dang: sems can tshogs la dbang byed rnams: bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rtags yin no:

sgrub dang las sbyor gzhan du shes: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: dkar gsum gtor ma chab kyis bran/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā ba bi shud+dho3 haṃ: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: sarba ka ri sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas: dkon mchog gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas: gnas mchog dam pa 'dir ni gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: hūm̐: snod bcud 'jig rten skyong bar dam bcas pa: rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir dbang bsgyur ba'i: phyogs skyong bcu dang 'jig rten lha chen brgyad: klu chen brgyad dang drag po gza' chen brgyad: mkha' la dbang bsgyur rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad: gnod sbyin brgyad dang pañtsi ka la sogs: dpal gyi btsun mo ha ri ka dang ni: 'phrog ma'i sras bu lnga brgya 'khor dang bcas: gzhan yang phyi yi gtor mar dbang mdzad pa'i: rdo rje rigs kyi srung ma thugs dam can: mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di bzhes la: khyod kyi ci 'dod longs spyod 'byung gyur cig: bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs srung du gsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: ces brjod gtor ma gtsang sar btang: dkyil 'khor bsdus te smon lam btab: bdag gis sgom bzlas rgya chen bgyis pa yis: khams gsum sems can ma lus thams cad kun: mi khom brgyad dang ngan song gsum: deng nas thar nas byang chub thob par shog: rnam 'joms sgrub pa'i phrin las 'di: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas bod du byon dus: phyi ma'i don la dgongs nas brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i rked la sbas pa'i:

gter bdag rdo rje legs pa la bcol lo: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sa ma yā: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ 1$0000230byang zang zang lha brag gi rked brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i rked nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000300 ༄༅: gsang mtshan thugs kyi sgrub pa las: rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bag chags stobs sbyong bzhugs so: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis zhus pa: kye slob dpon chen po lags: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: mi rnams spyod ngan sna tshogs kyis: lha mi grib kyis phog gyur nas: bsam pa'i don rnams mi 'grub cing: 'gro ba bde ba'i skabs med pas: bag chags stobs sbyong sgrub pa zhu: zhes gsol ba btab pas: bka' bstsal pa: rgyal po chen po legs par gson cig: ma 'ongs lnga brgya tha ma'i dus: mi rnams log pa'i dbang song bas: bla ma mi chen ngo lta byed: mkhan po dge bshes 'khrug las dar: dge 'dun sdom med khe tshong byed: sngags pa grong chog bon ltar 'khyams: sgom chen stong skad grong ltag 'dzin: bon po nor phyir mtshams med spyod: rgyal po'i ming btags khrims la g.yel: blon po phra mas rang gzhan phung: skye bo mna' za sdig la rngams: bud med smad 'tshong rang bu gsod: ming sring nal byed pha spun 'khrug: slob dpon dam nyams nang 'khrug 'ong: dpon la g.yog gis nang bslus byed: de ltar spyod ngan sna tshogs kyis: lha mi mi gtsang grib phog pas: yi dam lha yi dngos grub yal: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung skyob bral: 'go ba'i lha rnams bdud du babs: yul lha gyes shing bkra mi shis: mi phyugs nad rigs sna tshogs 'ong: char chu mi 'bab sad ser mang: 'bru rnams mi smin mu ge 'ong: nang 'khrug 'khon dang mtshon kha langs: mtha' yi dmag gis bod khams 'joms: mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad mang:

sems can bde ba'i go skabs med: de yi sdug bsngal skyob pa'i phyir: rdo rje rnam 'joms sgrub thabs bstan: rgyal po thugs ngal ma mdzad cig: ces gsungs so: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ gsang ba'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo:

rdo rje rnam 'joms bsgrub pa la: bsnyen pa dang sgrub pas rang gzhan gyi don bya ba la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las: ྈྈྈྈ dang po la gang zag gtsang sbra dang ldan pa: bsnyen pa sngon du song bas: gnas gzhung dang mthun par stegs bu'i khar sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba ni: dbus su gru gsum mthing nag: zla gam gsum dmar po: phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi phyogs tshon: rtsibs mchan sngon po: gru chad ljang gu: sgo bzhi rta babs: rdor ra me ri sogs gzhan dang mthun par bris la: bum pa sgrub pa ni: dbus su bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par: srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang ma dang: bum rdzas nyer lnga rnams blug: mgul chings kha rgyan gzungs thag dang bcas pa bshams la: bgegs bskrad pa ni: gu gul dud pas bdug: oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba: lto ba ldir ba: zhabs zhum pa: kha g.yel ba: mchu 'phyang ba: mgrin pa phra ba: lha'i na bza'i mgul chings dang: dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan: thugs rje thabs kyi gzungs thag dang bcas pa: nang bcud rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi lhar gyur par bsam: dkar gtor zlum po chos skyong dang: dpal mgon bdud cu rtsa lnga: gzhi bdag gtor ma phyi mchod rnams bsham: mdun du rdo rje dril bu: khrus long rnams sngon du 'gro bar bya: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni tho rangs snga dro khrus byas: gtsang ma'i gos gyon bde ba'i stan la 'dug la: skyabs 'gro bya: sems bskyed pa ni: sems can thams cad kyi don du: bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par bya: de'i phyir du rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgom bzlas mchod bstod kyi rim pa la 'jug par bya'o: sarba satwa ni bho dha ya: bho dha ya: 'di ni sems bskyed gzungs yin pas 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed do:

srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni: stong pa'i ngang las: paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du: sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang: lte ba mthing kha hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa: de las 'od zer 'phros: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i bla bre sa gzhi ra bas gtams pas: phyi rol na ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su: hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros: 'phags pa mchod: sems can gyi don byas: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: zhabs gnyis stangs stabs su bgrad pa: phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rje phyar ba: g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten pa: sku stod la dar sngon po'i na bza' dang: sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba: sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa: zhal mche ba gtsigs pa: spyan gsum dang ldan pa: smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser 'khyug pa: dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil ba: 'bar ba'i nyams dang ldan pa: de'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par ā: thugs kar hūm̐: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas: rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam 'joms la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa ma ya dza: na mo bskal pa thog ma med pa nas: bdag gis sdig pa'i las ngan bsags pa rnams: dus 'di nyid du so sor bshags par bgyi: bdag nyid dang po khyed la gus pa yis: gsang ba'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la: yang dag don la gnas phyir skyabs su mchi: bde bar gshegs pa ma lus thams cad dang: 'gro ba'i don mdzad byang chub sems dpa' la: bdag gis gces par 'dzin pa'i lus 'di 'bul: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyis: dge ba'i las rnams bgyis pa thams cad kun: dus 'di nyid du byang chub mchog tu bsngo:

bla med dkon mchog gsum dang gdung 'dzin rnams: mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro drug don la bzhugs: chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor du gsol: ces pas rang nyid la thim pas rdo rje'i go bgos par bsam la: oṃ sarba bhid dha badz+ra badz+ra: s+pho ṭa badz+ra badz+ra: ka ta badz+ra badz+ra: ma ta badz+ra badz+ra: ma tha badz+ra badz+ra: aṭ+ṭa ha sa nī la badz+ra badz+ra: su badz+rā ye swā hā: 'di ni srung ba'i gzungs sngags yin: bdag lus rdo rje'i gur du bsam: sus kyang mi chod mi shigs bsgom: mtshams gcad pa ni: bgegs gtor byin gyis brlabs nas: rdo rje dril bu bzung la 'di skad do: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'dir gnas lha klu dang: gnod sbyin ma lus dregs pa'i tshogs: 'gro ba kun la phan gdags phyir: byang chub sems la gnas gyis la: sgrib gnyis byang ba'i phrin las mdzod: bar du gcod pa'i gdon tshogs rnams: mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: phyag na rdo rje thugs khros nas: khro rgyal bcu yi tshogs dang bcas: lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog: tad+ya thā: oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra: ma tha ma tha badz+ra: dhu na dhu na badz+ra: da ha da ha badz+ra: pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra: dha ra dha ra badz+ra: dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra: dhā ru na dhā ru na badz+ra: tshin+dha tshin+dha badz+ra: bin+dha bin+dha badz+ra: hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: 'di ni khro bo bcu yi gzungs: bgegs bskrad mtshams bcad khro bos gtams: mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong yangs chen po ni: thugs rje'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba: 'gro ba'i don du yi ge hūm̐: de las dbang chen gzhal yas chags: e las mthing nag nam mkha'i klong: yaṃ las sngo skya rlung gi dkyil: khaṃ las dkar po chu yi dkyil: suṃ las ser po sa yi dkyil: raṃ las dmar po me yi dal: de steng bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang: sgo dang ka ba rgyan rnams dang: sna tshogs rin po che las grub: lha snam rin chen pha gu dang:

drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab mdzes: 'dod yon lha mo mang pos brgyan: rdo rje'i ra ba me dpung 'bar: mdzes pa'i me tog dpag bsam shing: snyan pa'i bya skad sna tshogs sgrog: dbus su gru gsum zla gam gsum: phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhir ldan: dbus dang 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du: paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan: ma dang a las nyi zla brtsegs: rtsibs dang phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i klu: dbus su klu chen dregs pa'i gdan: de steng mthing nag yi ge hūm̐: de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las: rdo rje rtse lnga pa ru gyur: de las 'phros 'dus bskyed pa'i lha: dbus su khro bo rnam 'joms ni: sngo nag rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: shar du khro bo gtum po ni: mthing nag rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: lho ru khro bo be con ni: ser nag rdo rje rin chen bsnams: nub tu khro bo rta mchog ni: dmar nag rdo rje pad+ma bsnams: byang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil: ljang nag rgya gram ral gri 'dzin: kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum mche gtsigs sma ra ser: dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil: stag lpags sbrul gyi rgyan dang ldan: sgo bzhir nyi ma'i gdan steng du: shar du lcags kyu dkar mo ni: lcags kyu g.yas la bum pa g.yon: lho ru zhags pa ser mo ni: zhags pa g.yas la bum pa g.yon: nub tu lcags sgrog dmar mo ni: lcags sgrog g.yas la bum pa g.yon: byang du dril bu ljang gu ni: dril bu g.yas la bum pa g.yon: sgo srung lha mo chen mo bzhi: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bsgrad: khro mo'i chas dang ldan par bsam: dbang bskur ba ni: spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga gsum: 'khor lo pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa ltar: rigs lnga ye shes lnga dang ldan: nyon mongs dag phyir dbang bskur ro: na maḥs man+ta badz+rā nāṃ:

sarba ba le ta a badz+ra badz+ra: dza ya ma hā bā le: ka ta be: ta tra be: a tsa le: ma dha la: mā he: a ti badz+ra: ma hā ba le: bhe ga ra na ra na: 'di ni lha yis dbang bskur sngags: gtso bo'i dbu la rigs lngas brgyan: khro bo bzhi la rigs bzhis brgyan: sgo srung bzhi la rdo rje ni: rtse lnga phyed pas brgyan par bsgom: spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin las: 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa: bgegs dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i: rdo rje rnam 'joms 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ha ra ha ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥbadz+ra dha rā ye swā hā: pra ha ra pra ha ra badz+ra pra bhan dza nā ya swā hā: sa ma ya dza: 'di ni spyan 'dren sngags yin pas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan drang ngo: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: gzhal yas pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: rdo rje rnam 'joms 'khor bcas rnams: bdag dang 'gro la brtse ba'i phyir: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: ma tis+thi ra badz+ra: shu tis+thi ra badz+ra: pra tis+thi ra badz+ra: ma hā badz+ra a pra ti ha ta badz+ra: a mo gha badz+ra: e h+ye hi badz+ra: shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra ye swā hā: 'di ni bzhugs su gsol ba'i sngags: bdag don mdzad cing bzhugs su gsol: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa yi: gsang bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: na mo rat+na tra yā ya: na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye: ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye: a ti pū ho: 'di ni phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i sngags: lha la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mchod pa rnams a mṛta sa bsang: swa bhā wa sa sbyang: bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod yon gyi phung po dang: phyi mchod rnams lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil: me tog bdug spos: snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rnams dang:

gzhan yang rol mo'i bye brag la sogs pa phyi nang gi mchod pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur: oṃ ar+ghaṃ: pā d+yaṃ: puṣ+pe: dhū pe: ā lo ke: gan+dhe: nai wid+ya: shab+da āḥhūm̐: gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rin chen 'bar ba'i gtor snod du: gtor ma ye shes mchod pa'i tshogs: 'dod yon lha mos rab brgyan pa: bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra ma hā bha liṃ ta khā hi: phyi mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na: mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang: bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di: bcom ldan rdo rje rnams 'joms kyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag sogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bhi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na: zhabs bsil ji snyed yod pa dang: bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di: bcom ldan rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bhi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na: me tog ji snyed yod pa dang: bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di: bcom ldan rdo rje rnams 'joms kyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag sogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bhi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na: bdug spos ji snyed yod pa dang: bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di: bcom ldan rdo rje rnams 'joms kyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag sogs dngos grub stsol:

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bhi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na: snang gsal ji snyed yod pa dang: bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di: bcom ldan rdo rje rnams 'joms kyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag sogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bhi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na: dri mchog ji snyed yod pa dang: bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di: bcom ldan rdo rje rnams 'joms kyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag sogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bhi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na: zhal zas ji snyed yod pa dang: bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di: bcom ldan rdo rje rnams 'joms kyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag sogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bhi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra nai wid+ya pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan dag na: rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang: bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di: bcom ldan rdo rje rnams 'joms kyi: lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag sogs dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bhi dhā ra sa pa ri wā ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: bzlas pa bya ba ni: bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i nang du hūm̐ sngon po la sngags phreng g.yas skor du bsam: gzungs thag nas bzung la bzlas pa byas pas: bdag gi zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas:

bum nang gi lha'i zhal du zhugs: thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas thugs rgyud bskul: sku'i cha las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang zhing 'od zer gyis bdag gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam la sgrub pa'i sngags 'di bzla: na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya: hu lu hu lu: tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha: bhan+dha bhan+dha: ha na ha na: a mṛte hūm̐ phaṭa: snying po'i don ni 'di lta ste: mi chod mi shigs bden pa'i don: sra ba brtan pa'i rang bzhin te: thams cad du ni thogs pa med: de bzhin pham pa med pa 'o: 'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas pa yis: mtsho chen skam dang chu chen chad: sems can mang po bsgral ba dang: rdzas rnams khol zhing lud pa rnams: sgrub pa'i dus kyi rtags yin no: bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan rdo rje rnam 'joms ni: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: drag po'i phrin las ma lus kun: sgrub par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong: gzhal yas pad+ma nyi zla dang: klu chen dregs pa'i gdan steng du: stangs stabs khro tshul bzhugs la bstod: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing: g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar: g.yon pa dril bu dku la brten: rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku stod dar gyi na bza' gsol: stag dang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan: rin chen dbu rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i: rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzhad pa'i zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: sma ra dmar ser gyen la 'khyug: spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs: rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsung gi nga ros stong gsum gyi: bdud dpung ma lus skrag mdzad cing: dug gsum ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i: rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: rang bzhin zhi ba'i ngang nyid las: thugs rjes rab tu khros pa yis: rdo rje khro bo'i skur bstan pa'i: rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul:

zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kyis: ma lus bdud dpung 'joms mdzad pa: khro rgyal bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam thar sgo bzhi srung mdzad pa: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: phyi nang bar chad ma lus srung: sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: khro rgyal rdo rje rnam 'joms la: rnam pa kun tu gus pa yis: dus gsum rtag tu gsol ba 'debs: thugs rjes byin gyis brlab tu gsol: bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi: bag chags rkyen dbang mi gtsang dang: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa: sgrib pa'i las rnams byang bar mdzod: phyi nang bar chad rkyen rnams kun: ma lus thams cad zhi nas kyang: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub rnams: ma lus myur du bstsal du gsol: khyed la bstod cing gsol ba yis: bcom ldan khyed dang mi 'bral zhing: khyod kyi go 'phang myur thob nas: khyed bzhin 'gro ba 'dul bar shog: bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang: sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang: khyad par du bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol:

dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis la gtor ma 'bul ba ni: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: sarba ka ri sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa lngas bsngos la: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'khor dang bcas: dkon mchog gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas: gnas mchog dam pa 'dir ni gshegs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: hūm̐: snod bcud 'jig rten skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i: rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir dbang bsgyur ba'i: phyogs skyong bcu dang 'jig rten lha chen brgyad: klu chen brgyad dang drag po gza' chen brgyad: mkha' la dbang bsgyur rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad: gnod sbyin brgyad dang pañtsi ka la sogs: dpal gyi btsun mo ha ri ka dang ni: 'phrog ma'i sras bu lnga brgya 'khor dang bcas: gzhan yang phyi yi gtor ma dbang mdzad pa'i: rdo rje rigs kyi srung ma thugs dam can: mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di bzhes la: khyed kyi ci 'dod longs spyod 'byung gyur cig: bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs srung du gsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: ces gtor ma btang ngo: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni: hūm̐: rdo rje rnam 'joms lha tshogs rnams: 'gro ba sems can don slad du: chos kyi dbyings nas byon pa ni: sems can don kun mdzad nas kyang: slar yang skye med klong du bsdu: badz+ra muṃ: zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs: dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum chu nus ldan du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub blang: khrus gsol bya ba ni: sa mtho sar khrus long dang bum pa thogs la: bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong: yul lha gzhi bdag lha mi rnams kyi nyams grib mi gtsang ba'i skyon thams cad dag par bsam la:
